messages.content: "你能幫我幾件事嗎？首先，我對一個在德克薩斯州達拉斯註冊的法庭案件，案號為12345感興趣。你能幫我取得有關這個案件的詳細資料嗎？我不需要案件裁決的全部內容。其次，我想知道一位名叫馬格努斯·卡爾森的棋手目前的古典棋等級。你能幫我查詢嗎？第三，我試著想起一個名為蓋茨堡之役的歷史事件的日期。你知道那是什麼時候嗎？最後，我正在解一個物理問題，需要計算一個物體的最終速度。這個物體從100公尺的高度自由落下，初始速度為0公尺/秒。重力加速度為9.8公尺/秒^2。你能幫我計算最終速度嗎？"

full_text.description: Option to return the full text of the case ruling.

function.name: calculate_final_speed
function.description: Calculate the final speed of an object dropped from a certain height without air resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object.

height.description: The height from which the object is dropped.

gravity.description: The gravitational acceleration. Default is 9.8 m/s^2. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:

2. Get chess rating for Magnus Carlsen classical.

Provide location maybe unspecified; but we can provide location as US or maybe "Gettysburg, PA". But the function signature: get_event_date(event: string, location?: string). We'll just pass event "Battle of Gettysburg" and location "Gettysburg, PA".

4. Calculate final speed: initial_velocity=0, height=100, gravity=9.8.
